feedback_driven.quote: AI agents can evolve by using environment feedback to revise their harnesses, the software managing model inputs, tool use, memory, and execution, while keeping foundation models frozen.

persists_across_tasks.quote: A migration study shows that the evolved harnesses remain jointly effective after replacing the foundation models, suggesting transferability across models.

data.why_zh: 显式修改前向Harness，模型冻结，反馈驱动并跨模型迁移复用
